items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 217:1
items.html: The external vessels in the ten Sefirot, in BYA, which are the two vessels of the flesh and the skin, in which the external Nefesh and Ruach [clothe], also have a relation of surrounding lights to the ten Sefirot. For it is impossible that the two lights of Haya and Yechida will return to the Partzuf, unless these five vessels of ZON return to be internal vessels of the Partzuf, as above in answer 185. And the lights of Haya and Yechida are also the ones that clarify these vessels of ZON, to make them fit to be internal vessels, and therefore the external vessels are discerned as the aspect of surrounding vessels of the ten Sefirot. However, the surrounding lights themselves cannot clothe in them, since they are the aspect of ZON, which separated from the vessels of the body, and the vessels of the surroundings are made only from the ZON that separated from the lights of the head, for the surrounding lights have no grip except in the head and the GAR, as is known. (Item 177).
